temporal-correction.text: Attempted to remove the derived date field and use the raw timestamp directly.
The attempt failed because one-day ranges returned inaccurate grouped results.
The accepted replacement keeps the date field and adds an explicit projection before grouping.
The regression test asserts exact one-day range boundaries and grouped totals.
A cache timeout was observed in a separate worker.

cross-component-change.text: The widget shape endpoint returns grouped series to its consumers.
The shaping symbol converts database rows into the endpoint response.
The dashboard consumer expects every requested dimension in the grouped response.
The aggregate events table supplies dimensions and measures to the shaping symbol.
The contract test fails when the third requested dimension is lost.
The handoff says to preserve all dimensions and rerun the endpoint contract test.

branch-aware-history.text: On main, the parser accepts the current schema and rejects the legacy alias.
On the release branch, persisted documents still use the legacy alias.
Hide the alias from new public requests but retain read compatibility for persisted documents.
Removing the alias from runtime deserialization broke existing saved documents.
The compatibility test loads a legacy persisted document and writes only the current schema.
